dct_description_sm: This dataset contains geolocations of **Côte d'Ivoire's primary schools** as identified by **Enveritas' satellite detection algorithm** in July 2019. Enveritas updates this dataset with on-the-ground observations, which consist of field agents going to the identified locations and confirming the presence of primary schools. The last update dates back from April 2021. For more information on the methodology, do not hesitate to [contact us](https://enveritas.org/).
